sources.title: Neighborhood Councils (Certified) — PACOIMA NC
sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Bureau of Engineering / GIS Mapping Division
sources.license_notes: City of Los Angeles public data provided as-is for informational use; no dataset-specific license is stated.
limitations: This is the official certified Neighborhood Council boundary, not a parcel or construction boundary.

sources.title: Streets (Centerline)
sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Bureau of Engineering / GIS Mapping Division via Los Angeles GeoHub
sources.data_vintage: Live service snapshot retrieved 2026-08-25; per-feature LST_MODF_DT retained where published
sources.license_notes: City of Los Angeles public data is provided as-is for informational use; the City does not warrant completeness, accuracy, or fitness for a particular purpose.

fields.AutoID: Service-declared object identifier used for stable pagination and deduplication
fields.STATUS: Published one-character status code; the layer provides no coded-value definition
fields.ST_SUBTYPE: Published street subtype code; the layer provides no coded-value definition
fields.LST_MODF_DT: Published per-feature last-modified timestamp when available
fields.BSS_ST_CLASS: Published Bureau of Street Services class code; the layer provides no coded-value definition

limitations: Centerlines represent street alignment, not road width, parcel ownership, right-of-way clearance, pavement material, pavement condition, or construction feasibility.
The snapshot contains features intersecting the Pacoima AOI bounding envelope; downstream processing must clip or spatially filter against the exact committed Pacoima boundary.
Undefined status, subtype, and BSS class codes are retained without assigning invented meanings.

sources.title: Pavement Condition
sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Bureau of Street Services via NavigateLA
sources.license_notes: City of Los Angeles public data is provided as-is for informational use; the City does not warrant completeness, accuracy, or fitness for a particular purpose.

fields.Class: Published class code retained without invented expansion
fields.Surface: Published nonempty surface code retained without invented expansion
fields.Width: Published segment width value; the service metadata does not state a unit
fields.PCI_Category: Published Good, Fair, or Poor pavement condition category

limitations: A mapped pavement-condition segment establishes direct pavement inventory geometry but not ownership clearance, treatment compatibility, current field condition, traction, glare, drainage, radiant exposure, permits, or constructability.
Surface and class codes are retained as published because the service metadata provides no coded-value definitions.
The source response is queried by the Pacoima bounding envelope; candidate generation clips it to the exact committed Pacoima boundary.

geometry_provenance.query_aoi: Bounding envelope derived from data/processed/pacoima_aoi.geojson; candidates clipped to exact boundary

sources.title: FortyGuard Heatmap API — TCM, persistence, exceedance, and time of measure
sources.data_vintage: Active TCM and persistence: 2026-08-20; historical exceedance and peak-time context: 2024-07-15
sources.license_notes: Cached hackathon API outputs are retained for this project under the provider account terms; public redistribution rights are not inferred.

fields.persistence: Vendor-returned hours above the configured 30 °C threshold

limitations: The outputs are model evidence for relative screening, not a site forecast, health-risk estimate, or guaranteed intervention effect.
Historical exceedance and peak time are not contemporaneous with the active TCM and persistence layers.

sources.title: FortyGuard Street View Segmentation API
sources.data_vintage: Twenty cached exact-site frames with vendor image dates spanning 2017-05-01 through 2025-12-01
sources.license_notes: Cached hackathon API outputs are retained for this project under the provider account terms; public redistribution rights are not inferred.
limitations: A dated camera frame does not prove current conditions, all-day shade, right-of-way, utilities, or construction feasibility.
Evidence is limited to the deterministic 20-site sample; other sites remain explicitly unavailable.

sources.title: FortyGuard Environmental Parameters API
sources.data_vintage: Ten cached finalist point requests observed at 2026-08-20 14:00, vendor timezone UTC−08:00
sources.license_notes: Cached hackathon API outputs are retained for this project under the provider account terms; public redistribution rights are not inferred.

fields.clear_sky_ghi: Vendor-returned clear-sky GHI value; unit is not stated in the endpoint schema

limitations: Single-hour point outputs are explanation context only and are not used in ranking.
The fields do not establish medical risk, individual exposure, or intervention feasibility.

sources.title: FortyGuard Satellite View Segmentation API
sources.data_vintage: One cached 2026 overhead segmentation for the deterministic top pavement finalist
sources.license_notes: Cached hackathon API outputs are retained for this project under the provider account terms; public redistribution rights are not inferred.
limitations: One overhead classification is surface-screening context only and is not used to rank candidates.
It does not establish ownership, current condition, treatment area, safety, permits, product compatibility, or construction feasibility.

sources.title: FortyGuard Heat Intelligence API — quarantined urban report
sources.data_vintage: One point report submitted for the 2026-08-20 Pacoima TCM observation and completed 2026-08-25
sources.license_notes: The cached hackathon API report is retained for audit under the provider account terms; public redistribution rights are not inferred.

fields.activity_id: Stored vendor activity identifier for the one governed submission
fields.request_hash: Canonical hash of the exact point, temperature, date, and urban analysis request
fields.report_sha256: SHA-256 of the cached PDF downloaded from the temporary result link
fields.observed_credit_delta: Measured successful completion cost from before/after credit usage

limitations: The report is quarantined and ineligible for explanations because it misread the supplied Celsius temperature as Fahrenheit and described Pacoima coordinates as Long Beach / Signal Hill.
It introduces uncited estimates and projections absent from COOLSPOT's structured evidence and is never used in ranking, optimization, or the core demo path.

sources.title: LA Metro April 2024 Bus Stop Patronage
sources.publisher: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority via Los Angeles GeoHub
sources.data_vintage: April 2024 patronage; 2024 Bus Stop Hub analysis snapshot
sources.license_notes: Published by LA Metro for bus-stop planning reference. Retain attribution; the hosted layer metadata states no dataset-specific license.
limitations: The ArcGIS layer does not define the DX, SA, and SU abbreviations; raw values are cached without assigning day-type meanings.
The Bus Stop Hub describes its ridership criterion as published boardings and alightings from a 2024 snapshot; it is not live ridership.

sources.title: 2020–2024 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates and ACS 2024 Tracts
sources.license_notes: Public Census Summary File content may be analyzed and displayed; identify Census as the source and do not imply endorsement.

fields.B01001_E001: Total population and sex-by-age denominator estimate
fields.B01001_E020..B01001_E025: Male population age 65 and over components
fields.B01001_E044..B01001_E049: Female population age 65 and over components
fields.B08201_E002: Households with no vehicle available estimate

limitations: ACS values are survey estimates with sampling uncertainty; margins of error are not yet incorporated in the MVP score.
Tract estimates describe residents and households, not people present at a site at a particular time.
